raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Reduce per-token frontend CPU work by reusing chat SSE frame templates and polling Harmony completed messages only after message-ending tokens. Raw-stream consumers and per-token metadata retain model serialization.

Related: [#52875](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52875) applies frame templating to `/v1/completions`; this change targets `/v1/chat/completions` and Harmony parsing, so it does not duplicate that PR. AI assistance was used to review and prepare this contribution.

## Claims

- Eligible non-final content/reasoning frames preserve the protocol models' JSON bytes while avoiding repeated envelope construction and serialization.
- Harmony avoids repeatedly rebuilding all completed messages for every generated token; message completion, malformed-stream recovery and EOS handling remain equivalent.
- Supplied historical H100 measurements report 14,567 → 30,350 output tok/s for Qwen3-0.6B chat at c256 (+108.4%), and 10,293 → 11,818 for long-output gpt-oss-20b chat at c256 (+14.8%) with Harmony gating alone.

## Validation

Current CPU checks against upstream `349b21487a`:

- `pytest tests/entrypoints/openai/chat_completion/test_serving_chat.py -k 'frame_template and not TestGPTOSS' -q`: **19 passed**.
- `pytest tests/parser/test_harmony.py -k 'stop_token_poll_matches_every_token_poll or messages_read_once_per_stop_token' -q`: **71 passed**.
- `pytest tests/parser/test_harmony.py -q`: **117 passed; 26 existing structured-output setup errors**, all at automatic device detection on this macOS host.
- Independent comparison loading the actual unmodified upstream Harmony module: **70 stream/chunking cases identical**; the completed-message getter runs **413 times before versus 3 after** for the regression stream (expected: 3).
- Supplemental isolated check using the exact current protocol/model/helper definitions: **32,533 byte-parity and fallback assertions passed**, with pydantic 2.14.2 and orjson 3.13.0. This is supplemental CPU validation, not a GPU server test.
- Full pinned pre-commit and commit-message hooks **passed** on `d0196c4`, including mypy, Ruff, documentation and CI tethering checks.
- The added real-server regression validates SSE bytes against protocol serialization using the existing gpt-oss server fixture. GPU serving and this new server regression have **not** been run on this host.

The supplied benchmark/evaluation summaries were produced at `0eeae6a`, not rerun during this port. H100 runs used ABBA ordering, two repetitions per arm. Representative output-tok/s results:

| Workload | Base | Change | Rep spread, base/change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Qwen3-0.6B, random 64/512, c256 | 14,566.69 | 30,349.99 | 0.8% / 1.1% |
| Qwen3-8B, random 64/512, c256 | 13,825.27 | 16,316.35 | 0.4% / 0.1% |
| gpt-oss-20b, ShareGPT cap 1536, c256, Harmony only | 10,292.91 | 11,818.37 | 3.3% / 1.5% |

The supplied frontend checks report identical SSE bytes for six deterministic request shapes and 8/8 greedy Harmony chat comparisons. The sampled n=2 shape can vary between runs. These summaries are historical evidence; raw GPU captures and fresh full CI results are not included here.

Example reproduction for the first benchmark, on each revision with one default API server:

```bash
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
vllm bench serve --model Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B --backend openai-chat \
  --endpoint /v1/chat/completions --dataset-name random \
  --random-input-len 64 --random-output-len 512 --random-range-ratio 0 \
  --num-prompts 2048 --max-concurrency 256 --ignore-eos
```

## Details

The template is derived once per choice through the same chunk builder and protocol serializer. Content/reasoning fields are encoded only for exact supported delta types; tool calls, subclasses, extras, unencodable text, terminal chunks, and requests needing per-token metadata use the model path. Raw-generator overrides and instrumentation retain their original dispatch path. Harmony reads completed messages after the encoding's stop tokens and after EOS, when completion can occur.

Both changes reuse existing frontend APIs and add no dependency or flag. Existing chat CI selects the serialization tests; the Harmony parser suite is added to the CPU reasoning/renderers job and removed from its tethering exception.

Benefits depend on frontend saturation. In the supplied Qwen3-8B random 512/128 c512 run, throughput improved 3.3% and TTFT p50 fell 68%, while TPOT p50 rose 19.8% as requests entered decode earlier. Instrumenting the raw generator disables frame templating. GPU/server validation remains pending and must complete before merge.

@@ -516,3 +516,16 @@ If you observe that GPU utilization is lower than expected, CPU contention may b
 vLLM supports multiple attention backends optimized for different hardware and use cases. The backend is automatically selected based on your GPU architecture, model type, and configuration, but you can also manually specify one for optimal performance.
 
 For detailed information on available backends, their feature support, and how to configure them, see the [Attention Backend Feature Support](../design/attention_backends.md) documentation.
+
+## Chat streaming serialization
+
+The OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint reuses a per-choice SSE frame template for
+non-final text and reasoning chunks. It preserves the protocol models' JSON
+serialization, while requests with logprobs, token IDs, continuous usage, or
+delta logging use model serialization for every chunk. Tool-call, role, finish,
+and final usage chunks continue to use the model path. Integrations that
+override or wrap the raw chat-stream generator also retain that path.
+
+For Harmony models, completed messages are read only after a message-ending
+token or end of stream. Both optimizations are automatic and reduce frontend
+CPU work; their throughput impact depends on model size and serving load.

+_FRAME_TEXTS = [
+    "Hello",
+    ' "quoted" \\ back\nslash\t {"content":"x"}',
+    "\x00\x1f\x7f\x85",
+    "\u2028\u2029 </script>",
+    "café \u4e2d\u6587 \U0001f680",
+    "",
+]

+
+def _frame_delta(mode: str, step: int, text: str, finished: bool) -> DeltaMessage:
+    if finished:
+        return DeltaMessage()
+    if mode == "reasoning":
+        # Assigned after construction, like HarmonyParser does; the step that
+        # ends reasoning carries both fields.
+        delta = DeltaMessage()
+        if step <= 2:
+            delta.reasoning = text
+        if step >= 2:
+            delta.content = text
+        return delta
+    if mode == "tools" and step >= 3:
+        first = step == 3
+        function = DeltaFunctionCall(
+            name="get_weather" if first else None, arguments=text
+        )
+        return DeltaMessage(
+            tool_calls=[
+                DeltaToolCall(
+                    index=0,
+                    id="call_0" if first else None,
+                    type="function" if first else None,
+                    function=function,
+                )
+            ]
+        )
+    if mode == "subclass":
+        return CohereDeltaMessage(content=text)
+    if mode == "extra":
+        return DeltaMessage(content=text, extra_field=step)
+    return DeltaMessage(content=text)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def frame_engine_client():
+    """Mock the external engine service; construct frontend objects normally."""
+    config = VllmConfig(
+        model_config=ModelConfig(model=MODEL_NAME, max_model_len=128),
+        device_config=DeviceConfig(device="cpu"),
+    )
+    engine = MagicMock(spec=AsyncLLM)
+    engine.vllm_config = config
+    engine.model_config = config.model_config
+    engine.renderer = HfRenderer(config, get_tokenizer(MODEL_NAME))
+    engine.input_processor = InputProcessor(config, renderer=engine.renderer)
+    return engine
+
+
+def _build_frame_serving(
+    engine,
+    cls: type[OpenAIServingChat] = OpenAIServingChat,
+    **kwargs,
+) -> OpenAIServingChat:
+    models = OpenAIServingModels(
+        engine_client=engine, base_model_paths=BASE_MODEL_PATHS
+    )
+    return cls(
+        engine,
+        models,
+        response_role="assistant",
+        online_renderer=_build_online_renderer(engine, models.registry),
+        request_logger=RequestLogger(max_log_len=None),
+        chat_template=CHAT_TEMPLATE,
+        chat_template_content_format="auto",
+        **kwargs,
+    )
+
+
+def _frame_outputs(
+    n: int, kv_transfer_params: dict[str, Any] | None = None
+) -> list[RequestOutput]:
+    """One output per token and choice, then a final one per choice."""
+    outputs = []
+    for step, text in enumerate([*_FRAME_TEXTS, "!"]):
+        finished = step == len(_FRAME_TEXTS)
+        for index in range(n):
+            token_id = 100 + step
+            result = _make_metrics_request_output(metrics=None, token_ids=(token_id,))
+            completion = result.outputs[0]
+            completion.index = index
+            completion.text = text
+            completion.finish_reason = "stop" if finished else None
+            completion.logprobs = [
+                {token_id: Logprob(logprob=-0.5, rank=1, decoded_token=text)}
+            ]
+            result.finished = finished and index == n - 1
+            result.kv_transfer_params = kv_transfer_params if finished else None
+            outputs.append(result)
+    return outputs
+
+
+async def _collect_stream(
+    serving: OpenAIServingChat,
+    request: ChatCompletionRequest,
+    outputs: list[RequestOutput],
+    raw: bool = False,
+) -> list[Any]:
+    method = (
+        serving.chat_completion_stream_generator_raw
+        if raw
+        else serving.chat_completion_stream_generator
+    )
+    return [
+        chunk
+        async for chunk in method(
+            request,
+            _stream_request_outputs(*outputs),
+            "chatcmpl-frames",
+            "test-model",
+            conversation=list(request.messages),
+            tokenizer=serving.renderer.tokenizer,
+            request_metadata=RequestResponseMetadata(request_id="chatcmpl-frames"),
+        )
+    ]
+
+
+def _record_template_frames(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> list[str]:
+    rendered: list[str] = []
+
+    def recording(render):
+        def spy(self, value):
+            frame = render(self, value)
+            if frame is not None:
+                rendered.append(frame)
+            return frame
+
+        return spy
+
+    for name in ("render_content", "render_delta"):
+        render = getattr(_DeltaFrameTemplate, name)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(_DeltaFrameTemplate, name, recording(render))
+    return rendered
+
+
+_FRAME_CASES: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
+    "plain": {},
+    "include_usage": {"request": {"stream_options": {"include_usage": True}}},
+    "continuous_usage": {
+        "request": {
+            "stream_options": {"include_usage": True, "continuous_usage_stats": True}
+        },
+        "templated": 0,
+    },
+    "force_include_usage": {
+        "serving": {"enable_force_include_usage": True},
+        "templated": 0,
+    },
+    "logprobs": {"request": {"logprobs": True}, "templated": 0},
+    "return_token_ids": {"request": {"return_token_ids": True}, "templated": 0},
+    "n2_kv_transfer": {
+        "n": 2,
+        "kv_transfer_params": {"remote_block_ids": [1]},
+    },
+    "echo": {
+        "request": {
+            "echo": True,
+            "add_generation_prompt": False,
+            "messages": [
+                {"role": "user", "content": "Test"},
+                {"role": "assistant", "content": "Prefix"},
+            ],
+        }
+    },
+    "log_deltas": {
+        "serving": {"enable_log_outputs": True, "enable_log_deltas": True},
+        "templated": 0,
+    },
+    "log_outputs_without_deltas": {
+        "serving": {"enable_log_outputs": True, "enable_log_deltas": False}
+    },
+}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", list(_FRAME_CASES))
+async def test_stream_frame_template_matches_model_path(
+    case: str, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, frame_engine_client, caplog
+):
+    """Frames rendered from the template equal the pydantic frames, byte for byte,
+    output logging sees the same calls, chunks with per-token metadata keep the
+    model path, and the raw generator still yields the models."""
+    spec = _FRAME_CASES[case]
+    n = spec.get("n", 1)
+    serving = _build_frame_serving(frame_engine_client, **spec.get("serving", {}))
+    request = ChatCompletionRequest(
+        **{
+            "model": "test-model",
+            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Test"}],
+            "stream": True,
+            "n": n,
+            **spec.get("request", {}),
+        }
+    )
+    kv_transfer_params = spec.get("kv_transfer_params")
+    # Both runs need the same `created`.
+    monkeypatch.setattr(time, "time", lambda: 1_700_000_000.0)
+    rendered = _record_template_frames(monkeypatch)
+    caplog.set_level(logging.INFO)
+    caplog.clear()
+
+    frames = await _collect_stream(
+        serving, request, _frame_outputs(n, kv_transfer_params)
+    )
+    logged = [record.getMessage() for record in caplog.records]
+    caplog.clear()
+    raw_chunks = await _collect_stream(
+        serving, request, _frame_outputs(n, kv_transfer_params), raw=True
+    )
+    model_frames = [_sse_frame(chunk) for chunk in raw_chunks]
+
+    assert frames == [*model_frames, "data: [DONE]\n\n"]
+    assert [record.getMessage() for record in caplog.records] == logged
+    assert len(rendered) == spec.get("templated", n * len(_FRAME_TEXTS))
+    assert all(frame in frames for frame in rendered)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_stream_frame_template_keeps_error_for_unencodable_text(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, frame_engine_client
+):
+    """Text pydantic cannot serialize still ends the stream with its error."""
+    serving = _build_frame_serving(frame_engine_client)
+    request = ChatCompletionRequest(
+        model="test-model", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Test"}], stream=True
+    )
+
+    def outputs() -> list[RequestOutput]:
+        results = _frame_outputs(1)
+        results[1].outputs[0].text = "lone \ud800"
+        return results
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(time, "time", lambda: 1_700_000_000.0)
